messages.author: daf017f67eba24e8
messages.subject: prescheduling .parallel
parts:
Hi-

I'm using plyr functions with .parallel=TRUE to run a ton of tasks which only take a few miliseconds. In such a case, dividing the tasks evenly over some number of processors is more efficient than having an individual process for each. I use the doMC backend for foreach which uses multicore. both of these permit the option preschedule=TRUE to get the desired configuration. but I dont see that I can get there from plyr. if I can, please inform. otherwise this could be a desirable feature.

Thanks, 
James

messages.author: 7e921b60a6dff156
messages.subject: Re: prescheduling .parallel
parts:
While it would be nice to expose more foreach functionality, the OP
should also note that `preschedule=TRUE` is the default anyway, which
I think is what is desired right now anyway.

Another way to tackle this problem of passing more opts through to
foreach that doesn't involve adding args to *ply functions is to have
the `llply` function sniff for settings set in R's global `options`
and inject them when calling %dopar%, eg. one might set something like
`options(foreach.mc.preschedule=TRUE)`, then plyr code could look for
options() that are prefixed with `foreach.` and send them along.

-steve
